text: If you feel anxiety and stress, sit upright, place your palm on the lower part of your abdomen. On the exhalation, begin to hum quietly “Mmmmm” on a low note. At first the vibration may be felt in the chest (or even in the clavicle area). Your task is, by selecting the note, the features of the sound and relaxation of the body, to lower the vibration into the lower abdomen. This exercise calms the vagus nerve, breathing becomes deeper, and inside appears a feeling of silence and wholeness.
